lines: You've got a missile on your six, break right!
Viper One, you're hit! Shake it off!
Viper One, you're taking heavy damage. Watch yourself.
Target destroyed. Keep it up, Viper One.
Nice and gentle. Viper One is on deck.
Bolter, bolter! Power up and go around!
Viper One, call the ball. Follow the meatball, keep it centered.
Hold brake to transition to hover, then settle onto the deck.
Welcome to basic flight training, Viper One. Hold your phone upright, like a steering wheel.
Tilt the phone left or right to bank and turn. Fly through the gates.
Lean the top of the phone to pitch up or down. Climb through the high gate, then dive through the low one.
Hold boost for afterburner. Brake to slow down. Speed is life, but don't let her stall.
Target drones ahead. Get close, put the circle on them, and hold the gun button.
Now missiles. Keep a target in front of you until the diamond turns red, then tap missile.
Tap target to switch between targets. Tap S P for your special weapon. It can lock several targets at once.
Outstanding flying. You're cleared for combat operations, Viper One.
Viper One, you're hooked up on cat one. Hold boost to launch.
Overwatch to Viper One. Four bandits and two bombers inbound from the north. Protect the carrier at all costs.
Priority targets are the bombers. Don't let them reach the fleet.
More contacts on radar. Second wave, bearing three five zero.
Airspace is clear. Viper One, return to mother. You're cleared to land.
We've been hit! The carrier is taking damage!
Viper Two, on your wing. Let's dance.
Viper One, enemy fighters are hiding in the cloud layer. Clear the sky.
Second squadron climbing out of the clouds. Engage.
Watch it, these two are flying differently. Aces.
That's the last of them. Outstanding work up here, Viper One.
I can't see a thing in these clouds!
Spirit, this is Raptor One. We'll keep the fighters off you. Put steel on those ships.
Enemy fleet in range. Five destroyers. Drop when ready.
Spirit, use your flares against incoming missiles.
Fleet neutralized. Spirit, turn for home. Good hunting.
Viper One, enemy surface group to the east, with air cover. Guided bombs are cleared hot.
Half the fleet is burning. Keep pressing.
Surface group destroyed. Nice work, Viper One.
Raid incoming! Six bombers with fighter escort, heading straight for the carrier.
Bombers closing on the fleet. Stop them, Viper!
Raid repelled. Viper One, bring your Lightning home. Vertical landing approved.
Viper One, four contacts above the clouds. Red tails. It's the Crimson squadron.
So you're the one they call Viper. Let's see if you live up to it.
Not bad. Crimson flight, break and attack!
Only the leader remains. Take him down, Viper One!
Crimson One is down! Viper One, you are the ace of aces.
He's on my tail! Get him off me!
Basic training. Learn to fly, to shoot, and to lock missiles. Live fire drones only. Nobody shoots back.
Dawn patrol off the coast. Launch from the carrier, intercept an enemy strike package, and land back on deck.
Enemy fighters are operating above a solid cloud deck. Climb, find them, and clear the sky.
Take the B-2 Spirit deep into enemy waters. Raptors will escort you. Destroy the enemy fleet.
An enemy surface group is shelling the coast. Use guided bombs to sink every ship.
Bombers are heading for our carrier. Launch, intercept, and bring your F-35B back with a vertical landing.
The Crimson squadron. The best they have. Four aces, one sky. Only one of you comes home.
